brain._max_tokens: How many tokens ONE turn may write, for anyone who is not master - thinking AND chat share this number. Measured on glm-5.3-flash: about 4 characters per token, so a full 2000-character Discord message costs roughly 493 tokens, and reasoning tokens are billed to the same budget. 400 was cutting answers off before they started. 500 is a full reply with a little headroom, and deliberately not more: it is the ceiling on strangers.
brain._owner_max_tokens: Master's ceiling. High on purpose: his replies are capped at 2000 characters by Discord anyway, and a tight cap costs him the answer rather than the money - spend.py never prices his turns. Set it to 0 to omit the field and let the provider decide, which is a literal no-limit.

_chat_history: How much of a channel's OWN conversation rides into a prompt. max_messages is how far back a channel is remembered at all - the ring's maxlen, past which a line is simply gone. max_chars is what that conversation may spend in the prompt, and past it the OLDEST lines are folded into a condensed digest rather than dropped. They shorten a conversation in different places: max_messages forgets, max_chars condenses. Both are bounded in lulu_bot.py, so a typo falls back to the shipped value instead of emptying a room or filling the prompt. Read at boot only - a new number lands on her next restart. To clear one conversation RIGHT NOW, master types `newchat` in that channel.
_stt_paths: These are ABSOLUTE now, and that is only legal because C:\lulu-apps is a named EXTERNAL_ROOT in paths.py. Master moved the runtimes out of her folder on 2026-09-21. An absolute path anywhere else - C:\Windows, or any folder a human has not written into that tuple - is refused by paths.resolve() exactly as it always was. If whisper ever stops resolving, check EXTERNAL_ROOTS before you touch this file.
_stt_ffmpeg: Where ffmpeg lives. LEAVE THIS OUT and whisper_stt looks inside her own folder first - which is where a hand-dropped ffmpeg/ffmpeg.exe belongs, and the only place a binary can live because run-bot.cmd sets no PATH at all. ffmpeg did NOT move (it is 242 MB but it is not on the critical path the way python and whisper are), so the default is still correct. Set it to a bare name like "ffmpeg" only to force an old-style PATH lookup.
